numericTagging: Every numeric measurement is tagged by row.numericStatus or its nearest containing status block. Atomic numbers, array indices, formula subscripts, charges and unit definitions are DERIVED identifiers/conventions. Version and date strings identify provenance. Null means unavailable; never a fabricated zero.

method.wallTiming: Single fresh final RHF kernel call; excludes molecule build, geometry optimisation, stability probes. C60 uses frontier.py timing. Runs may share CPU with frontier solve or geometry preparation; wall times are observations, not isolated performance claims.

scope.interpretation: F5 names no extra DIATOMICS/HYDRIDES/ORGANIC roster; populate from present rows. Include every S4b name, S4c named molecule, conditional iodine/xenon candidate; carbonyls instantiated as Ni(CO)4, Fe(CO)5, Cr(CO)6, explicitly class representatives. Twenty amino acids and five nucleobases declared families; glycine merged once; original app groups preserved. A-T uses a published benchmark reference; the built G-C topology and constrained minimum remain unverified.

recordBytes.why: Full square float64 C, full epsilon and occupation vectors plus decimal 2 KB allowance. Decimal 2 KB is 2000 bytes, consistent with the read cache-budget plan. Explicit binary 2 KiB alternatives add 48 bytes per defined record. Early raw/app checkpoints used the binary allowance; census.json normalises estimates only, without changing measurements. Excludes JSON text expansion, names above allowance, response arrays, grids, transport overhead.

scope.gate: In census-input roster order (present app order first, then named candidates); unique Hill composition+charge AND newly introduced element/topgroup/fixed motif; OR declared family. Only passing rows seed novelty. Gate pass does not certify scientific readiness.
